records.title: Esade Talent Scholarships (MSc and MBA)
records.deadline_display: Calls for these scholarship applications are generic and targeted at all those who meet the legally established criteria.

source.raw_extract:
### MSc Talent Scholarships

These scholarships are for students to complete official **MBA and MSc programs**. Candidates with demonstrated talent and financial need are encouraged to apply. Our Talent Attraction Committee will study their applications to confirm that candidates meet the established requirements.

The amount of these scholarships covers between 50% and 85% of their tuition fees. Calls for these scholarship applications are generic and targeted at all those who meet the legally established criteria.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Calls for these scholarship applications are generic and targeted at all those who meet the legally established criteria.
source.notes: Two official Esade pages were fetched in full (Scholarship Program overview and Scholarship Program detail). Neither publishes a call date, opening date or closing date for the MSc/MBA Talent Scholarships; the only statement about the calls is the verbatim sentence quoted above. No date was inferred. Deadline wording that does exist on other Esade pages belongs to different items and was therefore not used as evidence for this record (see rejected_sources). Page carries only a generic '© 2026 Esade Ramon Llull University' footer, no cycle reference, hence as_of = null.

rejected_sources.reason: Fetched and read: contains deadlines for other items only - 'the deadline for applying for an Excellence Award is July 15th 2026 (for the 2026 intake)' (Excellence Award, not Talent Scholarship) and 'Application deadline: June 15' under the external Fundación Princesa de Girona scholarship. The Esade Need-based/Talent Scholarship section on the same page states only 'Financial aid is open to all applicants once admitted to the MBA Program' with no date.

Not fetched; rejected on category grounds. Programme admissions deadlines (e.g. staged 30 Sep 2026 ... 30 Jun 2027 rounds) are a generic admissions deadline for a different process and are not evidence for a scholarship call date (brief section 5).

records.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - Bilateral Program (Type A)
records.deadline_display: Online application (www.campuschina.org) and the corresponding application documents should be submitted in the system before February 8, 2026.

source.publisher: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Estonia
source.raw_extract:
2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship Application

2025-11-08 00:04

The 2026/2027 Chinese Government Scholarship is now open for application. Online application (www.campuschina.org) and the corresponding application documents should be submitted in the system before February 8, 2026. There is no need to send paper materials to the embassy.

Time Frames

1) From now on to February 8, 2026

Applicants check the website (www.campuschina.org) for information about Chinese universities and scholarship programs, contact their favorite Chinese universities and obtain the Pre-Admission Documents, submit their online application. Estonian Agency Number is 2331, The study abroad program is of type A.

2) February 9 to February 28, 2026

The embassy organises the interview, and sends all recommended applications to China Scholarship Council for final review.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Online application (www.campuschina.org) and the corresponding application documents should be submitted in the system before February 8, 2026.
source.notes: The notice is Estonia-specific (Estonian Agency Number 2331) but explicitly confirms the programme type in the record's title: 'The study abroad program is of type A'. The deadline it publishes, 8 February 2026, is in the past as of the 2026-10-05 retrieval date, so per brief section 6 the stale date is not written and not moved to the next cycle. The embassy's own Notice index (fetched) was checked for a 2027/2028 cycle notice: the 2026/2027 notice dated 2025-11-08 is still the most recent Chinese Government Scholarship notice listed, so no current or future deadline is published. The record is flagged 'quarantined' in the shard; that DB flag was not acted on, only reported. Confidence MEDIUM because the deadline is an embassy-channel deadline for one country route rather than a CSC-wide deadline, and because the authoritative CSC portal could not be reached (see examined).

source.raw_extract:
### Application period

The application round for the ARUA Scholarship usually opens in early February every year.

Applicants who have completed an application for an international degree programme at Lund University as their first choice will be notified by email when the scholarship application period opens.

You will not be able to apply until you have received the email with the link to the scholarship application portal in February.

(How to apply, same page) Once you have received the email with the link to the scholarship application portal in February, you can apply for an ARUA Scholarship.

Two other dates on the same page were deliberately NOT used: 'The application deadline for studies is 15 January and the deadline for the application fee and supporting documents is in early February' belongs to the degree-programme application at universityadmissions.se, i.e. a different process from the ARUA scholarship round (brief section 5).

records.title: World in Serbia Project Scholarships of the Government of the Republic of Serbia
records.deadline_display: The deadline for submitting application forms with supporting documentation is no later than 1st June 2026.

source.publisher: Ministry of Education, Science and Technological Development of the Republic of Serbia
source.as_of: Document dated 'Belgrade, February 2026'; project description for Serbian-language study in 2026/2027 and enrolment in 2027/2028
source.raw_extract:
Application Deadline

The deadline for submitting application forms with supporting documentation is no later than 1 st  June 2026. Documentation that is not translated in to English or Serbian will not be considered.

Candidates should submit their applications via the link https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSevQItl0KUaeWDHfofPfa539kcV_T2Gb0fuoUiCOC1KkPbt5A/viewform?usp=header, and send the scanned original documentation, as well as translations into Serbian or English certified by an authorized person, to the email address worldinserbia@prosveta.gov.rs.

(Nomination section, same document) The Ministry of Foreign Affairs transmits to the Ministry of Education the lists of nominated candidates, together with the application forms of all applicants, no later than 10 June. ... The decision on the final list of endorsed candidates, adopted by the Minister responsible for education no later than 26 June, is transmitted by the Ministry of Education to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the purpose of notifying the relevant embassies and all applicants.
source.exact_deadline_wording: The deadline for submitting application forms with supporting documentation is no later than 1st June 2026.
source.notes: Live PDF at the record's official_source_url was fetched and its text extracted locally. It gives a candidate deadline of 1 June 2026. The same ministry's live 'World in Serbia' page on the identical official domain gives a different candidate deadline for what appears to be the same 2026 round: window 10-26 June 2026, closing 26 June 2026. Both are official government sources on prosveta.gov.rs, they are not different programmes (the PDF's own internal milestones - MFA lists by 10 June, ministerial decision by 26 June, embassy notification 27 June-4 July - line up with the web page's 26 June / 3 July dates), so this is a genuine disagreement about the SAME deadline and is reported as CONFLICTING per brief section 6. Additionally, both candidate dates are already in the past as of the 2026-10-05 retrieval date, so no date could be written even if the sources agreed. Nothing was inferred for a 2027 cycle; the call is annual ('Every year, the Ministry of Education announces a competition') but no 2027 date is published anywhere fetched.

summary.note: All 7 records were researched against live official pages; every value carries a fetched URL plus a verbatim quote. No calendar date was written for this shard: three official pages publish an explicit deadline that has already passed for records carried as open/active (brief section 6 expired_mismatch), two describe recurring annual cycles with no fixed date, one has no published call date at all, and one has two official sources disagreeing on the same 2026 deadline.
